title: A red 'auto-compaction failed' error block stays in the transcript although kiln retried and the compaction succeeded; the progress row never says it is retrying
observed: kiln defect (UX). After the 3-minute timeout on part 1, the transcript gets an 'error' block: 'harness: auto-compaction failed: provider: stream interrupted: context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout ...)'. kiln immediately restarts compaction (log trigger=overflow) and it succeeds, but the spinner keeps saying 'Compacting conversation (part 1 of 2)' with its token counter dropping from 965 to 138, and then 'Brewing… 311s'. Nothing says it is a retry, and the error block is never superseded. A user reads this as compaction having failed, with no way to tell the turn recovered. The error text is also a Go transport error, not user language.
expected: Say 'compaction part 1 timed out, retrying…' in the progress row, and drop or downgrade the error once the retry succeeds. Show a plain-language reason.
